career_ladder.note: Assistant Commandant is the premier direct-entry Gazetted Officer rank (Group 'A') in the Indian Coast Guard under the Ministry of Defence. Officers command fast patrol vessels, hovercraft, maritime patrol aircraft squadrons (Dornier 228 / ALH Dhruv), and naval technical bases, advancing to flag rank up to Director General Coast Guard (Level 16).

steps.years: Apex Command of Indian Coast Guard

exam_scheme.note: Direct selection for Assistant Commandant is conducted through Coast Guard Common Admission Test (CGCAT) across five sequential stages: Stage-I Computer Based Screening Test (CGCAT); Stage-II Preliminary Selection Board (PSB) comprising CCAT cognitive test and Picture Perception & Discussion Test (PP&DT); Stage-III Final Selection Board (FSB) 5-day psychological testing, group tasks, and board interview; Stage-IV Special Medical Examination at military hospitals; Stage-V Final Induction and training at Indian Naval Academy (INA) Ezhimala.

papers.paper_name: Section A (General Duty): English (25 Qs), Reasoning & Numerical Ability (25 Qs), General Science & Math (25 Qs), General Knowledge (25 Qs)
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct, -1 mark per wrong answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Shortlisting for Stage-II PSB based on normalized merit cut-off

papers.paper_name: Section B (for Technical Mechanical / Electrical branches only): 50 core engineering MCQs
papers.negative_marking: +4 marks for correct, -1 mark per wrong answer
papers.qualifying_threshold: Required for Technical branch candidates in addition to Section A

stages.source_label: Indian Coast Guard — Stage-II Preliminary Selection Board Guidelines

papers.paper_name: Candidate Verification, Computerised Cognitive Aptitude Test (CCAT) and Picture Perception & Discussion Test (PP&DT)

stages.source_label: Indian Coast Guard — Stage-III Final Selection Board Assessment Protocol

papers.paper_name: 5-Day SSB Evaluation: Psychological Tests, Group Task Officer (GTO) indoor/outdoor tests, and Board Interview
papers.qualifying_threshold: Recommended by Final Selection Board for induction merit

stages.source_label: Indian Coast Guard — Medical Examination Standards for Commissioned Officers

papers.paper_name: Comprehensive Medical Fitness Examination at designated Command Military / Naval Hospital
papers.qualifying_threshold: Fit in Sea / Flying Medical Category

financial_package.note: Assistant Commandant is a Group 'A' Gazetted Officer post placed in Pay Matrix Level 10 (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500) under the 7th CPC. Officers are entitled to Central Dearness Allowance, Flying Allowance (for pilots), Sea Duty Allowance (for afloat appointments), House Rent Allowance or government officer bungalow/flat accommodation, and dedicated defence medical coverage.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Indian Coast Guard — Assistant Commandant (01/2025 Batch) Official Notification (Pay and Perks)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100: Dearness Allowance @ 58% is ₹32,538; HRA ranges from 10% (₹5,610 in Z class) to 30% (₹16,830 in X class); Transport Allowance is ₹7,200 + 58% DA on TA (₹11,376 in higher TPTA cities); plus Messing / Ration subsidy. Gross pay ranges from ~₹1,05,000 to ₹1,25,000. In-hand earnings after 10% NPS contribution (₹8,864) and tax withholding are approximately ₹90,000 to ₹1,08,000.
official_perks: Furnished officer residential quarters in Coast Guard or Naval officers enclaves
Flying Allowance (₹25,000/month) for Pilots and Observers upon successful qualification
Sea Duty Allowance when embarked on Coast Guard ships and patrol vessels
Free medical coverage for officer and family in Military Hospitals, Naval Hospitals, and empanelled superspeciality facilities
CSD Canteen card privileges for officers with four-wheeler and liquor purchase quota
Leave entitlement: 60 days Annual Leave and 20 days Casual Leave per year with LTC facilities

competition_benchmarks.note: Biannual gazetted officer intake across General Duty (GD), Commercial Pilot License (SSA), Technical (Mechanical/Aeronautical & Electrical/Electronics), and Law entries.

years.selectivity_ratio: 70 vacancies (GD: 50, Tech Engg: 10, Tech Elec: 10) in 01/2025 batch; ~1 in 1,070 selectivity
